text: ***Otherworldly Presence.*** You know the *Thaumaturgy* cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Fiendish Legacy trait.

effects.note: Uses the Fiendish Legacy spellcasting ability.
